feat.message: Add --json flag to all Artisan commands for machine-readable pipeline output
Add changelog:list command — list all releases with version, name, date, entry count
Add changelog:show command — show unreleased or specific version entries (--ver=x.y.z / --unreleased)
Add changelog:suggest-release command — auto-detect bump type from unreleased entries (breaking/feat/fix)
Add standalone MCP server (bin/changelog-mcp) for AI tools like Claude Code
Add .mcp.json.example template for MCP server configuration
